newsitem.title: UK: Clarke says British economy to grow 3.5 pct in 97.
newsitem.headline: Clarke says British economy to grow 3.5 pct in 97.

text.p: British finance minister Kenneth Clarke said on Tuesday he expected economic growth in 1997 to be 3.5 percent after estimated growth of 2.5 percent in 1996.
Clarke was presenting his annual budget to parliament. The 1997 growth forecast was higher than his previous forecast of 3.25 percent. The 1996 growth forecast was unchanged.
Clarke, the Chancellor of the Exchequer, said he saw consumer spending rising three percent in 1996 and by more than four percent in 1997.
Business investment should grow by more than 10 percent in 1997, he said.
